scope: Read-only source branch total, identified own branch share and brand-count treemaps for the three existing industries. Existing Demand eligibility, Supply criteria/ranking, profiles and source counts stay unchanged.

identifiedTotal.unclassifiedScopeEvidence: Not silently classified; retain source count separately and comparison bounds/review
identifiedTotal.intervalPolicy: Retain current own/competitor count bounds. No midpoint or upper bound is presented as an exact measured count.

ownBranchShare.labelMeaning: Our share of identified source branch inventory; not sales market share, capacity, customers or verified operating branches
ownBranchShare.denominator: Own + identified competitor branch records within the same selected industry/format/license scope, geography and source basis
ownBranchShare.exactZeroDenominator: Count0 is known; share is null/undefined_ratio, not0%. The renderer uses an explicit empty-basis state.
ownBranchShare.validZeroPercent: Own0 and competitor>0 means a measured0% proxy
ownBranchShare.validHundredPercent: Own>0 and competitor0 means100% of the identified inventory only
ownBranchShare.uncertainty: Scope/licence/allocation/reconciliation uncertainty stays review; expose conservative bounds with zero-denominator edge handling and never paint as an exact ratio. boundsKnown=false retains review0..100, not a guessed point.
ownBranchShare.aggregateRule: Ratio from one compatible raw parent vector; never average local ratios, percentiles or sum ambiguous fine display links.

mapPalette.semanticReuse: Renamed outlet-inventory proxy allowed by Location Profile evidence boundary; do not inherit the sales-share claim
mapPalette.intervalEdges: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive;100 inclusive in the final bin
mapPalette.themePolicy: Same exact original light LUT/HEX/direction in both themes; full analytical opacity
mapPalette.knownZeroCue: Class0 with an explicit measured-zero cue; undefined/missing/review remain neutral
mapPalette.existingCountScale: Original count41 LUT and fixed national same-grain quantile boundaries retained

geographyAdapters.province: Single nativeData.provinceRows vector selected by province code via provinceContextsById
geographyAdapters.district: Single nativeData.rows vector selected by exact native districtId
geographyAdapters.location: Single fineData.rows vector selected by exact reporting UUID; preserve runtime fine supply bounds

sourceAPI.indexing: Source-object indexes/cache do not rewrite native geography, counts or affiliation

coverage.complete: Identified comparison counts have exact compatible source/scope/assignment evidence; does not certify complete all-provider inventory or live operations
coverage.allProvidersComplete: Separate flag requiring no unknown or unclassified counts plus exact source comparison counts; not proof that the source has captured every operating branch
coverage.unknown: Unidentified U remains separate and is excluded from O+C and all share denominators
coverage.unclassified: Non-bank licence/scope evidence not yet resolved; keep separate and conservative comparison bounds
coverage.excluded: Exact known source dimensions outside selected format/license scope; not missing evidence
coverage.missingPolicy: Missing/failed/invalid/suppressed/out-of-scope/not-yet sources do not become0 or stale exact shares
coverage.treemapInReview: Observed source count rectangles may remain with visible incomplete/review caption; percentages withheld. No residual, upper-bound allocation or inferred branch is plotted.

fuel.limit: UNKNOWN is not unbranded or a competitor; merged source inventory does not certify current fuel types or operations

grocery.dimension: format:trade-brand key; filter exact selected format first
grocery.limit: PHARMACY and other formats are excluded when out of selected scope; do not infer current format/offerings from brand identity. Preserve known reconciliation bounds.

nonbank.dimension: Exact legal-company ID and source-supported licence scope; office_context is direct office inventory
nonbank.limit: Top10 selectable identities do not truncate competitors. Licence family is potential company scope, not branch-level offering; preserve assignment residual and licence uncertainty.

industryEvidence.commonLimits: Source inventory, source time and display geometry remain evidence-specific; coordinates and team POI edits never substitute for native area totals.

treemap.areaMeaning: Each rectangle area represents its observed source branch-count fraction; not sales/physical capacity or uncertain upper-bound share
treemap.panelGrouping: Keep positive own row +8 largest identified competitors + Other when needed; Other is an exact sum with inspectable named members
treemap.hoverGrouping: Compact count composition with exact Other aggregation and own row retained when positive
treemap.brandListCompleteness: A readable nonspatial list explicitly reveals additional40-row batches; no silent record truncation
treemap.identity: Original verified brand graphic and readable name where supported; theme fallback is retained, never crop/recolor/frame
treemap.palette: landometer-series-10-v8 soft fill and exact per-theme ink/token roles; stable brand-ID slot through sorting/filtering, readable labels/shape cues and>=1px separators
treemap.scopeOwner: Panel follows current navigation; country hover uses province vector, province hover uses district vector, district hover uses fine reporting row. Child paint is not a parent total.
treemap.accessibility: Decorative rectangle layer aria-hidden; named numeric nonspatial list and disclosure remain accessible. Missing/empty/review/loading have explicit captions.
treemap.interaction: Read-only composition and More disclosure; no criterion Apply, source write, team event or forced navigation
treemap.UIRuntimeStatus: Frozen runtime; current bounded automated and native evidence bound below. One actual boundary hover is not all-boundary coverage.

implementationSteps: Read the pinned source dimensions/scope adapters and test exact0/100/undefined ratios and unknown coverage first.
Implement the pure direct-vector count/share API with source rows, bounds and explicit flags; preserve existing screening/ranking.
Add fixed0..10041-LUT share alongside existing count/rate maps; totalcount uses relationtotal.
Reuse one treemap renderer in panel and the single boundary-hover owner, with compact/full limits and named list disclosure.
Test current raw-source/format/licence/geography/interval cases and all new renderer cases; inspect actual TH/EN narrow/desktop and theme contrast.
Bind fresh current suites/native screenshots/runtime SHA, update the full document, then allow release owner to reseal/source/provider/live/package.

productionPlan.readOnlyAdapter: Reproduce the same source/scope/preset/version keyed derived projection in the production analysis service; preserve tenant-authorized source access. The browser API is not proof of a shared server endpoint.
productionPlan.outputContract: Source metadata, direct grain/UUID, counts/ratios/bounds, coverage and named brand list must travel together. Cache by source hash/industry/own brand/scope/geography; reject stale context work.
productionPlan.laterEvidence: Sales share, capacity, traffic, customer capture and branch-level offerings need later verified evidence and independent metric names.

acceptance: Native parent vectors supply parent totals/distribution; no LAO crosswalk or POI-marker rollup.
Unknown U and unresolved licence evidence never silently become own/competitor exact counts.
O+C count0 stays known while0/0 share remains undefined; valid0/100 ratios retain percentage domain.
Exact fixed-domain41 share LUT matches pinned LDS bytes in both themes; no percentile stretch/opacity or color transformation.
Every plotted rectangle equals observed count fraction; Other preserves total and own remains inspectable.
Compact/full/list limits are explicit and actual labels remain readable; one actual hover is bounded evidence, not all-boundary coverage.
No new Demand membership, Supply ranking, saved criteria, source counts or map/camera/team mutation.
